title: ADR-001: Sovereign Atlassian Replacement
content:
# ADR-001: Sovereign Atlassian Replacement

## Status
Accepted

## Context
The Creative Liberation Engine requires task tracking and knowledge management capabilities equivalent to Jira and Confluence. Rather than integrating with Atlassian SaaS (which violates air-gap sovereignty), we build native replacements.

## Decision
- **Sentinel Track** replaces Jira with a Kanban board, sprint planner, and MCP tool bindings.
- **Scholar Hive** replaces Confluence with vectorized knowledge documents and semantic RAG.
- Both are exposed via a unified **Sovereign MCP Hub** on port 5056.

## Consequences
- Full air-gap compliance: zero external API dependencies.
- Agents can autonomously create, update, and transition issues via MCP protocol.
- All knowledge is vectorized in Qdrant for semantic retrieval.
- Sprint planning is automated with velocity tracking and agent auto-assignment.
author: CORTEX-Architect

title: Runbook: MCP Hub Deployment
content:
# MCP Hub Deployment Runbook

## Prerequisites
- Node.js 20+
- Qdrant running on 127.0.0.1:6333
- Ollama running on 127.0.0.1:11434 with all-minilm model

## Deploy Steps
1. SSH to NAS: `ssh -p 2000 jaharoni@127.0.0.1`
2. Navigate: `cd /app/genesis-deploy`
3. Build: `docker compose -f docker-compose.genesis.yml build mcp-hub`
4. Deploy: `docker compose -f docker-compose.genesis.yml up -d mcp-hub`
5. Verify: `curl http://localhost:5056/health`

## MCP Connection
Agents connect via SSE: `http://127.0.0.1:5056/mcp/sse`

## Troubleshooting
- Check logs: `docker logs mcp-hub`
- Data persistence: `/volume2/cle-engine/mcp-hub/data/`
- Port conflict: Ensure 5056 is not in use (sovereign-home-mesh uses 5055)

title: Guide: MCP Tool Reference
content:
# MCP Tool Reference

## Sentinel Track Tools
| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| track_list_issues | List issues with filters |
| track_create_issue | Create task/story/epic/bug |
| track_update_issue | Update issue fields |
| track_transition_issue | Move through status pipeline |
| track_delete_issue | Remove an issue |
| track_get_board | Get Kanban board with stats |

## Scholar Hive Tools
| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| hive_list_docs | List documents with filters |
| hive_create_doc | Create ADR/runbook/guide |
| hive_get_doc | Read full document content |
| hive_update_doc | Edit document |
| hive_delete_doc | Remove document |
| hive_semantic_search | Vector similarity search |

## System Tools
| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| system_stats | Get hub-wide statistics |

title: Guide: State Machine Transitions
content:
# Sentinel Track State Machine

Valid status transitions:

```
BACKLOG → IDEATION
IDEATION → DESIGN | BACKLOG
DESIGN → PLAN | IDEATION
PLAN → SHIP | DESIGN
SHIP → VALIDATION | PLAN
VALIDATION → DONE | SHIP
DONE → (terminal)
BLOCKED → any status
```

Transitions are enforced both via the REST API and MCP tools. Invalid transitions return a 400 error with the list of allowed target states.

All transitions are recorded in the audit log with agent identity and timestamp.
